mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, we have overcast skies and a temperature of 60 degrees at Harriet Park, while tonight we will see a full moon.

City news highlights a busy week for our local authorities, as the Verona Police Department released a summary of calls ranging from traffic citations to assisting our fire and EMS teams during medical emergencies.

We have plenty of activities coming up, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to trivia nights at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, with more live music and events scheduled throughout the week.
In their latest weekly report, the Verona Police Department noted that on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I after finding him asleep behind the wheel.
If you are looking for a treat, head over to Culver's to enjoy today's flavor, which is Pumpkin Pecan, as they remain open until 10 PM tonight.
